text:
Deep beneath the sparkling sea lived a curious little mermaid princess named Marina. She had a shimmering blue tail and the most beautiful singing voice in the ocean.

But more than anything, Marina was fascinated by the world above the waves — the world of humans.

On her fifteenth birthday, Marina swam to the surface for the first time. She watched a beautiful ship sailing through the night, lit up with lights and music. Then a storm struck! A handsome young prince fell overboard.

Marina dived down and saved his life.

She carried the unconscious prince to shore and sang softly to him until he was safe. When he opened his eyes, Marina was gone — afraid and shy. But her heart was captured completely.

She returned to the sea, but could think of nothing but the prince.

Desperate, Marina visited the sea witch, Ursula. "I can give you legs," she hissed, "in exchange for your beautiful voice!" She warned that if the prince married another, Marina would dissolve into sea foam.

Marina agreed. Her voice was taken, and she was given legs.

Marina walked on land — painfully, but with wonder at every step. The Prince found her on the beach and brought her to the palace. Unable to speak, she communicated only through her beautiful eyes and graceful dancing.

The Prince grew very fond of her.

But the Prince believed another girl had saved him that night, and married her. Marina's heart broke. As dawn approached, she faced dissolution into sea foam.

But Marina's sisters and the love of her family transformed her into a spirit of the air — free to do good forever.

Marina rose into the golden morning sky, light as a breath of wind, tears turning to shimmering droplets of dew. She had lost her love, but gained something greater — a soul, courage, and the freedom of a spirit who chose love over bitterness.

🌟 THE END 🌟

💡 Moral: True love means wanting the best for others!
